plan.title: Source two service lines from one PR

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the PR sourcing flow.
Allow Vendor A to be added during event creation.
Add the specifically named Vendor A to the event.
Publish the RFQ after its PR lines, template, schedule, and vendor are configured.
Confirm the event was created as a real published project.
Have Vendor A quote the event's activities from the vendor portal.
Confirm Vendor A's quote was accepted.
Verify the buyer sees Vendor A's direct response on the RFQ.
Close the bidding window so the submitted quotes can be compared in Master QCS.
Open the buyer's comparison grid for the quoted PR activities.
Confirm the response is attributed to the real Vendor A column.
Verify rate-times-quantity amounts and the total for every carried activity.
